text:
Which statement about aqueous weak acids is correct?
A
Weak acids are always dilute aqueous solutions.
B
Weak acids dissociate fully in aqueous solution.
C
When a weak acid is added to blue litmus paper, it stays blue.
D
When a weak acid is added to solid magnesium, effervescence is seen.

options.label: A
options.text: Weak acids are always dilute aqueous solutions.

options.label: B
options.text: Weak acids dissociate fully in aqueous solution.

options.label: C
options.text: When a weak acid is added to blue litmus paper, it stays blue.

options.label: D
options.text: When a weak acid is added to solid magnesium, effervescence is seen.
